description: Source code for a vector-based document search service implementing placeholder embedding and search functionalities, designed for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) integrations within a project. Provides methods for generating simple text embeddings, searching for similar documents, and contextual retrieval based on API request attributes.

classes.name: VectorService
classes.description: Service for vector-based document search and retrieval, including embedding generation, similarity search, and context extraction.

methods.name: bool generate_embeddings(self, document_id: UUID)
methods.description: Generates simple term-frequency embeddings for a specific document identified by UUID.

methods.name: List[float] _create_simple_embedding(self, text: str)
methods.description: Creates a basic embedding vector based on term frequency of predefined API-related terms within a text.

methods.name: List[Tuple[Document,List[str],float]] search_similar(self, query: str, document_ids: Optional[List[UUID]] = None, limit: int = 5)
methods.description: Performs a placeholder similarity search over documents using text matching and simple vector cosine similarity.

methods.name: float _cosine_similarity(self, vec1: List[float], vec2: List[float])
methods.description: Computes cosine similarity between two numeric vectors.

methods.name: List[str] get_context_for_request(self, method: str, path: str, document_ids: List[UUID])
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context chunks for an API request (method and path), based on similar document content.

methods.name: int reindex_all_documents(self)
methods.description: Regenerates embeddings for all stored documents.

ctags.pattern: /^    def search_similar(self, query: str, document_ids: Optional[List[UUID]] = None,$/
ctags.signature: (self, query: str, document_ids: Optional[List[UUID]] = None, limit: int = 5)
